messages:
alana_csm: drafting a compact 'Warmchain' runbook for AMs: chain = prefill -> conservative batching -> streaming fallback. want short paste-ready defaults + 3 quick checks to surface renewal risk.

ken_sre: +1. keep defaults conservative for Hosted. include circuit-breaker and a single command to run a warmup job.

mira_se: add an explicit note about sensitive-data customers: skip prefill and use only targeted prompts.

sam_am: renewal signals to call out: <50% expected sessions by day3, DAU drop >18% in 7d, or sustained p95 latency >800ms -> AM outreach.

alana_csm: paste-ready hosted defaults:
```yaml
warmchain:
  prefill: true
  prefill_window_h: 24
  batch:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_size: 10
    max_wait_ms: 120
  streaming:
    enabled: true
    min_tokens_to_stream: 6
  circuit_breaker:
    error_rate_threshold: 0.10
    cooldown_s: 300
```

ken_sre: one-shot warmup (ops):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"hosted-small","input":"example_prompt","prefill":true}'
```

mira_se: customer-facing line: "During the warmup window (usually 24-48 hours) we run small, targeted requests to reduce cold starts. You may see slightly higher latency and costs while caches populate; your AM will monitor and adjust."

sam_am: triage checks (one-liners): cache hit rate <40% -> verify prefix keys/prefill jobs; p95 >900ms -> reduce max_batch_size or lower max_wait_ms; error rate >CB -> page oncall.

alana_csm: we'll bundle this into a one-pager + feedback link and push to enablement. thanks all.
